name: List the trigger, action and condition types an automation can use
description: Return every building block of the automation builder. Use before adding steps, because add_trigger needs a trigger key, its source category and its internal_action_id from this response. Observed on the free account: triggers {"contacts": ["added_to_lists", "removed_from_lists", "contact_match_custom_filter", "contact_match_one_segment", "automation_date_attribute_contact_trigger_modified", "manual_trigger"], "email": ["email_opened", "email_clicked", "email_unsubscribed"], "forms": ["form_submitted"], "deals": ["deal_created", "deal_stage_updated", "task_created", "task_completed"], "product": ["back_in_stock", "price_drop", "back_in_stock_subscribed", "back_in_stock_expired"], "website": ["page_visited"], "coupon": ["unique_coupon_sent"], "WhatsApp": ["whatsapp-reply"], "custom": ["custom"]}; actions {"contacts": ["add_to_list", "remove_from_list", "update_contact_attribute", "blocklist_contact", "assign_a_user_to_a_contact", "delete_a_contact", "update_company_attribute"], "messaging": ["send_email", "send_sms", "sales_send_one_to_one_email_from_mailbox", "send_whatsapp", "email_notify", "migrated_email_notify"], "deals": ["create_task", "update_deal_attribute", "copy_a_deal", "create_a_deal"], "Automations": ["start_another_workflow", "go_to_step"], "Webhooks": ["call_webhook"], "product": ["remove_product_contact_association"]}; conditions ["add_delay", "if_else_bool_segmentation", "percentage_split", "wait_until"].

trigger_categories.description: category -> list of {key, action_type, internal_action_id, source, label}

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Observed in UI traffic, then replayed from inside the logged-in page. Labels are i18n keys, not readable names. Per-step configuration fields live in the 250 KB GET /v1/workflow/unified-ddl definition, which was not parsed.
